comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, the same low-wage return with all three elections answered own. The benefits exclusion lifts to the 5,000 maximum (the taxable benefit on line 1e falls 1,000 → 0, AGI 5,000 → 4,000), the earned income credit rises 1,709 → 4,089 (12,000 of earned income is inside the one-child phase-in), the additional child tax credit falls 1,575 → 1,425; line 33 3,284 → 5,514. The same election on the 48,250-wage return moves the credit the other way (345 → 3): the figure is the answer's, never the service's.
